item.title: Hannibal, Dionysus next up on Mardi Gras slate
item.description: C. Whitten Photography King Dionysus XLVI Larry Hotard and Queen Dionysus XLVI Tina LeBlanc were crowned at the 2025 Krewe of Dionysus ball in Berwick. Harden's Photography King Hannibal XLV Marquall Dixon and Queen XLV Katasha Willis-Brown have reigned since the Hannibal ball in 2025. The Krewe of Hannibal and the Krewe of Dionysus balls and tableaux are on the schedule for Saturday as the Mardi Gras season marches closer to the big day.
